content_sections.heading: JIPMER Project Nurse-II Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Nurse-II post under the ICMR-funded research project titled "Implementation and Evaluation of a Community-Based Drug Take-Back Program for Safe Disposal of Expired and Unused Medicines in rural areas of South Indian district: A Mixed-Methods Interventional Study".

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Project Nurse-II Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Fluency in Tamil and English. Willingness to undertake community/field work. Previous experience in community-based work, research studies, public health, or field data collection. Basic computer skills / MS-Word / Excel / PowerPoint / data-entry and research-documentation skills.

rows.qualification_required: Three-year General Nursing & Midwife (GNM) Course from a recognized institution/board.

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Project Nurse-II Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 28 years (as on the last date of receipt of applications, i.e., 21/10/2026).

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Project Nurse-II Salary
content_sections.text: Initial appointment will be given for 11 months for Year I, with extension based on performance. The total project duration is 3 years.

rows.pay_level_pay: Rs. 22,000/- per month (Rs. 20,000 + 10% HRA as sanctioned for Year I; no other allowances are payable)

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Project Nurse-II Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of a written test followed by an interview. The written test and interview shall carry 80% and 20% weightage respectively. Candidates will be shortlisted for interview based on written-test performance, in the ratio of 3–5 candidates per available post. Basic nursing/community health, medication safety and biomedical-waste management, nursing/technical knowledge, prior research/community experience, field-work suitability, teamwork, and willingness to travel.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JIPMER Project Nurse-II
content_sections.text: Download the official application form from the notification PDF. Print the application form in A4 size paper and fill it in with Block Letters using a BLUE PEN. Affix your recent passport-size photo on the application form (do not staple). Attach self-attested photocopies of proof of identity, age certificate, degrees/diplomas, experience certificates, and CV in the specified order. Scan the filled application form, CV, and all supporting documents into a single PDF file. Name the PDF file exactly as format: CandidateName_ProjectNurseII_2026_application (e.g., Rani_ProjectNurseII_2026_application). Send the complete application by email to [email protected] with the name of the post applied for in the email subject, on or before 21 October 2026 by 5:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Proof of Identity (Copy of Aadhaar card / Voter ID / Passport / Driving License) Certificate in support of age (Tenth equivalent / High School Certificate) Degrees / Diplomas Experience certificates CV Caste proof (SC/ST/OBC), if applicable

faq.question: Q1. What is JIPMER Project Nurse-II Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by JIPMER Karaikal campus to hire 1 Project Nurse-II on a contract basis for an ICMR-funded research project.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for JIPMER Project Nurse-II?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Project Nurse-II post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for JIPMER Project Nurse-II 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to send complete applications by email is 21 October 2026 before 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for JIPMER Project Nurse-II?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a three-year General Nursing & Midwife (GNM) Course from a recognized institution/board, along with fluency in Tamil and English.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for JIPMER Project Nurse-II?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 28 years as on 21/10/2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for JIPMER Project Nurse-II?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for JIPMER Project Nurse-II?
faq.answer: Candidates must fill out the prescribed application form, attach scanned self-attested documents and CV in a single PDF file named correctly, and email it to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for JIPMER Project Nurse-II?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a written test (80% weightage) followed by an interview (20% weightage).

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for JIPMER Project Nurse-II?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is Rs. 22,000/- per month (Rs. 20,000 + 10% HRA) for the first year.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job at JIPMER?
faq.answer: No, this position is purely on a contract basis for an externally sponsored project and does not offer any claim to a regular post in JIPMER.
